title: Choose The Right Headshot Subject
tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

checks.name: asks first (Which person in the photo is the user: the bearded man on the left or the short-haired blonde woman on the right?)

got.question: Which person should the headshot feature—the person on the left or the right?

faults.what: The output is a wide rectangular image rather than the requested square headshot.
The woman still wears a thin-strapped casual top with bare shoulders; professional clothing was not added.
Her original toothy smile has been replaced with a closed-mouth smile, and her facial appearance has shifted noticeably rather than faithfully preserving the source likeness.

judge.summary: The edit removes the man and beach, but fails the square format and professional clothing requirements while noticeably changing the woman's face and smile.

must_haves.item: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
must_haves.why: The portrait contains only a woman matching the selected subject's short blonde hairstyle and general appearance.

must_haves.item: Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
must_haves.why: The short blonde bob is retained, but the facial likeness has shifted and the broad, teeth-showing smile is replaced by a closed-mouth expression.

must_haves.item: The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
must_haves.why: No part of the man is visible.

must_haves.item: The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
must_haves.why: The beach is replaced with a plain gray background, but the casual thin-strapped top and bare shoulders remain.

must_haves.item: The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.
must_haves.why: The lighting looks natural and there are no obvious compositing artifacts, but the head-and-shoulders portrait is landscape rather than square.
